method: Built-in ImageGen generation using project images as style/architecture references; no Meshy or paid API fallback. Not a game screenshot or historical family photograph.
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: P-HOUSE front photograph illustration for the URMAN in-game family album; one finished landscape 3:2 full-frame image, 1800x1200 target. Create an original intimate summer rural Tatarstan family courtyard memory. Reference image 1 is the accepted URMAN house material/architecture language ONLY: modest low single-storey timber house, coherent horizontal log courses with clear interlocking corner ends, low pitched roof firmly bearing on walls, deep white carved window trim and restrained decorative roof edge; do NOT reproduce snow, NPC, exact winter facade or mosque. Reference image 2 is the existing P-FOREST album picture and supplies ONLY chromatic painterly realism, coherent brushwork and believable materials, not its winter landscape or people. Scene: eye-level quiet view toward the open low veranda of a lived-in Tatar log house, a worn blue-painted door jamb and one recognizable blue-painted wooden shutter at a window, an ordinary weathered brown garden chair in the yard and one mature crooked apple tree clearly behind the chair, with sparse small red/ochre apples among its leaves. These three landmarks must be immediately readable as a related courtyard composition, with real ground contact and believable scale. Shutter construction: three vertical weathered blue wooden planks joined by two horizontal wooden rails and one diagonal brace, attached with real dark metal pin hinges, naturally partly open, no floating panel. Chair: one modest hand-built brown wooden garden chair with three seat slats, two back slats and four legs. Light: paper-warm daylight, pale blue and lilac shadows, moss/olive greens and muted blue painted accents, warm wood but no yellow overall wash or sepia. Clear three layers of depth: close path and chair, material house/blue jamb/shutter in middle distance, apple tree and softened garden fence. Respect the humane contemplative feeling of the album: no horror, no magic, no portals. Keep architecture structurally plausible: each horizontal log bears on the next, consistent corner joints, properly framed rectangular windows, roof supported on walls and veranda supported on posts. No ornamental Russian onion domes, no fantasy cottage, no chalet. Painterly material realism with confident textured brushwork like reference 2, never toy-like low-poly. No people, no photographer, no photographer shadow, no camera equipment, no second impossible doorway, no writing, captions, border, watermark. This is an art candidate for W03 landmarks, NOT a documentary game screenshot; do not imply exact scene geometry.

existing family-album painterly surface treatment only; no copied people or winter setting

runtime_thumbnail.export: sips mechanical downscale of runtime front
